description: A comprehensive server-side essentials mod for Minecraft NeoForge servers, inspired by EssentialsX for Bukkit/Spigot.

mods.name: neoessentials
mods.description:
NeoEssentials is a mod that adds many useful commands and features to Minecraft servers. 
It is designed to enhance the gameplay experience for both players and server administrators.
